explanation: WTI is the main US benchmark.

body: What is a 'Christmas tree' in oil and gas?
options: An assembly of valves on top of a completed well
explanation: It controls flow from the well.

subject: ONG
body: What is the main purpose of a blowout preventer (BOP)?
options: To seal the well and control pressure during drilling
To pump oil to the refinery
explanation: It is a critical well-control barrier.

subject: ONG
body: Which is a function of drilling mud?
options: Carrying rock cuttings to the surface and controlling well pressure
explanation: It also cools and lubricates the bit.

subject: ONG
body: What is an FPSO?
options: A Floating Production, Storage and Offloading vessel
explanation: Bonga and Egina are FPSOs off Nigeria.

subject: ONG
body: Seismic surveys are used to
options: map rock layers underground to find possible oil and gas
explanation: They are part of exploration.

subject: ONG
body: Where was oil first discovered in commercial quantities in Nigeria (1956)?
explanation: Oloibiri is in present-day Bayelsa State.

subject: ONG
body: Nigeria first exported crude oil in
explanation: Exports began two years after the Oloibiri discovery.

explanation: OPEC co-ordinates oil policy among member countries.

subject: ONG
body: Which law, signed in 2021, overhauled Nigeria's petroleum industry?
options: Nigerian Oil and Gas Industry Content Development Act
explanation: It created new regulators and made NNPC a limited liability company.

subject: ONG
body: Under the PIA, which body regulates the upstream sector?
explanation: Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission.

subject: ONG
body: Under the PIA, which body regulates the midstream and downstream sectors?
explanation: Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority.

subject: ONG
body: Which body promotes Nigerian participation (local content) in the oil and gas industry?
explanation: Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board, set up by the 2010 Act.

subject: ONG
body: Under the PIA, oil companies fund host community trusts with what share of their annual operating expenditure?
explanation: The Host Communities Development Trusts.
